contea di ritrovamento: North East Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ DN VAL[--] ; R/ [SECVRI]TAS REI PVBLICAE

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust dademed draped right. Obverse inscription: DN VAL[--]. Reverse description: Victory advancing left holding wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECVRI]TAS REI PVBLICAE. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 17.4mm, Weight: 2.44gms, die axis: 6
